name: Dr. Rohan & Sneha Verma
text: Our honeymoon in Kashmir was like stepping straight into a fairytale! Bhat Tanzil Kashmir took care of every single detail—from the heated houseboat on Dal Lake with rose petals to our Gondola tickets in Gulmarg.

name: Amitabh & Priya Sen & Family
text: Traveling with elderly parents and two kids can be stressful, but the Bhat Tanzil Kashmir team organized a clean, comfortable Innova Crysta and wheelchair-friendly accommodations. Truly 5-star service.
